messages.description: The conversation: system (or developer), user, assistant and tool messages. A custom model answers after its own instructions, without the app's system messages; a base model reads them all.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens to answer with. Unset: up to the model's context limit.

max_completion_tokens.title: Max Completion Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: The same as max_tokens, under its newer name; it wins when both are set.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: 0 to 2: higher is more varied, 0 picks the likeliest token every time. Unset: the model's default; custom models answer at 0, the way their scores were measured.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Above 0, up to 1: sample only from the likeliest tokens whose probabilities add up to top_p.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Sample only from the k likeliest tokens. An extension vLLM and SGLang share.

min_p.title: Min P
min_p.description: 0 to 1: drop tokens less likely than min_p times the likeliest one. An engine extension.

presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: -2 to 2: above 0 favours tokens that have not appeared yet.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: -2 to 2: above 0 lowers a token's odds the more often it appeared.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Above 0, up to 2: above 1 discourages repeating any token seen so far. An engine extension.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Sample the same way for the same seed and inputs, as far as the engine allows.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Up to 4 texts that end the answer; the text itself is not returned.

n.description: How many answers; only 1 is supported.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Send the answer as server-sent events, ending with data: [DONE].

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: An OpenAI response_format: {"type": "text"}, {"type": "json_object"} or {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {"name": ..., "schema": {...}, "strict": true}}. A custom model's contract holds by default; a request's format can only narrow a model whose contract is free text, so a model answering with labels or its own schema refuses one.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Up to 128 functions the model may call. Each model family's chat template renders them, and its answer is read back as tool_calls: Qwen and Hermes <tool_call> JSON, Llama 3.1 and later JSON, Mistral [TOOL_CALLS] and gpt-oss harmony. A model answering with labels or a JSON schema takes no tools.

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description: auto (the default with tools) lets the model choose, none answers in text, required makes it call one, and {"type": "function", "function": {"name": ...}} makes it call that one.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: false keeps only the first call the model makes; true (the default) keeps all.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: none turns reasoning off; low, medium or high turn it on at that effort; unset keeps the model's default (off for custom models and the catalogue's Qwen3 bases). Qwen3 and GLM think or not, so any effort turns thinking on; gpt-oss always reasons at an effort; DeepSeek-R1 always reasons. The reasoning comes back apart from the answer, as message.reasoning_content.

safety.description: A minibrain extension: check the request with a safety model on this install (Llama Guard, ShieldGemma, Qwen3Guard, gpt-oss-safeguard), and the answer too with answers: true. A model with a safety model set in Settings or on its page is always checked by it; a request can add the answer check but not change or turn off that model. A blocked request answers with message.refusal and finish_reason content_filter.

finish_reason.title: Finish Reason
finish_reason.description: stop when the answer ended, length when max_tokens cut it, tool_calls when it calls tools, content_filter when the safety model blocked it.
